headline: A 2024 law directs the Treasury to mint commemorative coins honoring working dogs, with part of each sale going to America's VetDogs.
what_it_does: The law tells the Treasury Department to mint 50,000 $5 gold coins, 500,000 $1 silver coins, and 750,000 half-dollar clad coins. The coin designs must reflect working dogs' roles in detection, military service, therapy, and assistance. Coins may only be issued during the one-year period beginning January 1, 2027, and every sale must include a surcharge paid to America's VetDogs.

who_it_affects.group: People who buy the commemorative coins
who_it_affects.how: They can purchase these coins, and each sale includes a surcharge on top of the coin's price.
The charity receives the surcharge money from coin sales to pay for general expenses of its mission.
They gain access to a limited run of coins with designs honoring working dogs, available only during 2027.

when_it_takes_effect: The act became law on November 25, 2024, but coins may only be issued from January 1, 2027, through December 31, 2027.
